errors.name: AuthenticationRequired
errors.description: No account is logged in to the pages, or its session has ended.

main.description: Takes the address's hash out of the dev.knotless.emails record of the account logged in to this appview's web pages, as `knotless account email remove` does. Requires the session cookie the pages' login sets: the appview writes with the session it keeps for that account.

description: Takes back the claim to an email address of the account logged in to this appview's pages.
